Class PlotTable

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.spatial.PlotTable
public final class PlotTable extends Object
The data of the active sheet of the Bio7 table for plots (see Plot3D): the columns as numbers or texts and a dialog to select the columns of the roles of a plot (e.g., X, Y, Z and an optional group). If cells are selected in the table (also several ranges with Ctrl/Cmd or Shift) the dialog uses only the selected cells (an option of the dialog, see fromSelection). 
PlotTable.Selection s = PlotTable.select("Scatter Plot", "Select the columns", "X", "Y", "Z", "Group?");
if (s != null) {
        double[] x = s.numbers(0), y = s.numbers(1), z = s.numbers(2);
        String[] group = s.has(3) ? s.texts(3) : null;
}

    • select

      public static PlotTable.Selection select(String title, String description, String... roles)
      Opens a dialog to select the data of the roles of a plot in the active sheet of the Bio7 table, like the data ranges of a chart in LibreOffice: each role has a range of cells (e.g., B2:B51, several ranges separated by ';'), typed, chosen as a column or selected in the table with the button "Select" (the dialog is reduced to a bar and the selection of the table is taken over). The dialog doesn't block the table. A role with a '?' at the end is optional (e.g., "Group?"). The dialog has the settings of the plot, too: the title, the titles of the axes (with the names of the first three roles, not for less than three roles, e.g., a pie chart), logarithmic axes, the color map and the export action (see Selection.apply). If cells are selected in the table when the dialog is opened, the selected columns are the default ranges.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the dialog (e.g., the plot)
      description - a description (or null)
      roles - the roles (e.g., "X", "Y", "Z", "Group?")
      Returns:
      the selection or null (canceled or no table data)
